situation_context.trigger: site lacks identity and has some existing equipment

observation: site lacks a memorable theme or identity
some existing equipment remains on site
diagnosis: the problem is not insufficient equipment but a lack of spatial narrative

decision.downstream: secondary facilities added only after anchor succeeds

principle: The first move creates the centre. Everything else supports it.
boundary: do not apply when existing space already lacks basic safety functions
do not stack this pattern twice in the same site
